scheme_name: Monetary Relief to the Victim of Atrocities- Haryana
description:
The Monetary Relief to the Victim of Atrocities scheme is a significant welfare initiative launched by the Government of Haryana.

This scheme was officially launched on 1st January 2018.

It aims to provide financial assistance to victims of atrocities and their families.

The primary objective of this scheme is to ensure that victims receive timely monetary relief.

The scheme seeks to alleviate the financial burden on victims who have suffered due to social injustices.

The Haryana government has set a target to provide immediate financial aid to victims within a specific timeframe.

The scheme aims to provide relief to victims of various types of atrocities including physical assault and social discrimination.

Under this scheme, victims can receive a monetary relief amount of up to INR 5 lakh.

The exact amount of relief depends on the severity of the atrocity committed against the victim.

For instance, in cases of murder, the victim's family is entitled to receive INR 5 lakh.

In cases of grievous injury, the relief amount is set at INR 3 lakh.

For cases of rape or gang rape, the relief amount is also INR 3 lakh.

The scheme also provides INR 1 lakh for cases of physical assault that do not result in grievous injury.

Eligibility criteria for this scheme are clearly defined.

Victims must be residents of Haryana to qualify for the monetary relief.

There are no specific age limits for eligibility under this scheme.

However, the victims must be able to provide proof of the atrocity committed against them.

Income criteria are not strictly defined for this scheme.

This means that even individuals from higher income brackets can apply for relief if they are victims of atrocities.

The application process is straightforward and designed to be user-friendly.

Victims or their family members can apply for relief by visiting the nearest office of the Haryana Social Justice and Empowerment Department.

The application form can also be downloaded from the official website of the department.

Required documents include a copy of the FIR filed with the police.

Victims must also provide medical reports if applicable.

Aadhar card or any other government-issued identity proof is necessary for verification.

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the concerned authorities.

The review process typically takes about 30 days.

If approved, the monetary relief is disbursed directly to the victim's bank account.

The Haryana government has established a dedicated helpline for victims seeking assistance.

The helpline number is 1800 180 2022.

This helpline provides guidance on the application process and addresses any queries related to the scheme.

The scheme is implemented by the Haryana Social Justice and Empowerment Department.

This department is responsible for overseeing the welfare of marginalized and vulnerable sections of society.

The government has allocated a budget of INR 10 crore for this scheme in the financial year 2023-2024.

This budget is aimed at ensuring that sufficient funds are available to meet the needs of all eligible applicants.

The scheme has been well-received by the public since its inception.

It has been instrumental in providing timely support to victims who often face financial hardships.

The Haryana government has also conducted awareness campaigns to inform citizens about the scheme.

These campaigns aim to educate victims about their rights and the support available to them.

The scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Haryana government to combat social injustices.

It reflects the government's commitment to protecting the rights of vulnerable individuals.

The scheme is regularly reviewed and updated to address emerging issues faced by victims.

Statistical data indicates that over 1,000 applications have been processed under this scheme since its launch.

The approval rate for applications has been approximately 85 percent.

This high approval rate demonstrates the government's commitment to providing assistance.

The scheme also includes provisions for psychological support for victims.

Counseling services are made available through various NGOs and government agencies.

Victims are encouraged to seek psychological help to cope with the trauma they have experienced.

The Haryana government collaborates with various civil society organizations to enhance the reach of this scheme.

These collaborations help in identifying victims and providing them with necessary support.

The scheme has also been integrated with other welfare initiatives to provide comprehensive support.

For instance, victims may also be eligible for vocational training programs to help them reintegrate into society.

The government has established a monitoring committee to oversee the implementation of the scheme.

This committee is responsible for ensuring transparency and accountability in the disbursement of funds.

Regular audits are conducted to assess the effectiveness of the scheme.

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the services provided under the scheme.

The Haryana government aims to expand the scope of the scheme in the coming years.

Future plans include increasing the monetary relief amount based on inflation and rising costs.

The government is also considering the introduction of additional support services for victims.

This may include legal aid and rehabilitation programs.

The Monetary Relief to the Victim of Atrocities scheme is a vital step towards ensuring justice for victims.

It underscores the importance of government intervention in addressing social issues.

The scheme serves as a model for other states to follow in their efforts to support victims of atrocities.

Overall, the scheme is a crucial part of Haryana's commitment to social justice and empowerment.
